content: WhatsApp export tools fall into: (1) txt parsers -> structured objects (whatsapp-chat-parser npm, TS, ~219 stars, v4, daysFirst inference + parseAttachments, system msgs author null/System); (2) txt->document converters (whatsapp-export-md Python 2025: MD/HTML+media link/embed base64, smart filename resolution, JSON dump); (3) database parsers (WhatsApp-Chat-Exporter Python: Android/iOS DB + Crypt12/14/15 decryption, HTML+JSON+text, filtering, custom templates, per-chat); (4) analytics (WhatsR, whatsapp-chat-analyzer); (5) online converters (ChatToPDF, WAExport: PDF/Excel/CSV from TXT/ZIP). Common outputs: HTML, JSON, MD, TXT, CSV, Excel, PDF.
